incidents.title: Regional API 503 outage

incidents.metrics_note: Latency dashboards look normal but error_rate spiked to 42%.

incidents.title: Error spike after nightly deploy
incidents.summary: Checkout service error rate jumped from 0.1% to 18% five minutes after deploy v2.14.0 at 02:00 UTC.

incidents.title: Suspicious admin API access pattern
incidents.summary: SIEM alert: 340 admin API calls from unfamiliar IP ranges using a service account that should be dormant. Possible credential compromise.

incidents.title: Leaked production API key in public repo
incidents.summary: GitHub secret scanner flagged a live production API key committed to a public fork. Key has billing and data export scopes.

incidents.title: Primary replica lag causing stale reads
incidents.summary: Analytics replica lag exceeded 45 minutes. Downstream billing reconciliation jobs reading stale balances. Risk of incorrect invoices.

I-102.dashboard_summary: Latency green but error_rate critical — investigate gateway upstream.

runbooks.title: Database pool exhaustion
runbooks.content: DB-504 indicates connection pool exhaustion. Restart app servers, scale read replicas, and drain stale connections.

runbooks.title: API gateway 503 regional outage
runbooks.content: For regional 503 outages, fail over to secondary region, page platform on-call, and publish status page incident.

runbooks.title: Post-deploy error spike rollback
runbooks.content: When error rate spikes within 15 minutes of a deploy, rollback to previous version and open a deployment incident.

runbooks.title: Credential compromise response
runbooks.content: Revoke affected credentials immediately, force credential rotation, enable enhanced audit logging, and notify security team.

runbooks.title: Leaked API key remediation
runbooks.content: Revoke the exposed key, rotate secrets, scan git history for additional leaks, and audit recent API usage for exfiltration.

runbooks.title: Replica lag and stale reads
runbooks.content: Pause jobs that require strong consistency, promote replica or restore from backup, and verify replication before resuming billing jobs.
